description: Create AI music playlists for Spotify from moods, activities, genres, or song lists; search songs and manage playlists.

defaultPrompt: Create a private 25-song Spotify workout playlist with energetic rock and electronic music.
Show my accessible public Spotify playlists and let me choose one to explore.
Make new Spotify playlists private by default and show my saved setting.
interface.longDescription:
Turn a mood, activity, genre, or song list into a music playlist with AI, then save it to Spotify. Make a workout mix, find music for a road trip, or build a playlist around your favorite artists.

Search Spotify songs, add or remove tracks, rename playlists, update descriptions and privacy, and reorder songs in playlists you own. Browse your accessible public playlists and their songs in a playlist browser on supported hosts. Set your preferred privacy for newly created playlists.

A connected Spotify account is required. Playlist browsing is limited to the public playlists available through the current Spotify permissions; private and collaborative library browsing is unavailable. You can create private playlists. Song availability varies, and unmatched songs or partial results are reported. Panels depend on your host. This release supports Spotify only and does not control playback, provide listening-history statistics, or manage subscriptions.

publication.release_notes: Public Spotify release: create and manage playlists, search songs, edit playlist details, reorder songs, browse playlists in supported host panels, and choose default privacy for new playlists. Includes updated Spotify account connection handling.

positive.description: Core creation. Dedicated connected Spotify test account; authorize creation of one public three-song fixture for subsequent library and reorder cases.
positive.prompt: Create a public Spotify playlist called PlaylistAI Review containing Dreams by Fleetwood Mac, Take On Me by a-ha, and Billie Jean by Michael Jackson.
positive.expected_behavior: title=PlaylistAI Review; public=true; songNames contains three separate Song - Artist entries. Show only returned playlistUrl; report unmatched songs and warnings. Never claim success without returned URL or retry a partial success. Confirm all three songs are present before using this fixture in later cases.

positive.description: Catalog search without library changes. Connected Spotify test account.
positive.prompt: Find up to five Spotify versions of Dreams by Fleetwood Mac. Do not save anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Search query includes title and artist, limit<=5. Present returned tracks and available links; make no write calls.

positive.description: Browse and inspect library. Test account has an owned public PlaylistAI Review playlist with at least three tracks.
positive.prompt: Show my Spotify playlists in the playlist browser, then show the songs in PlaylistAI Review.
positive.expected_behavior: Open actual UI resource. Read playlist using its returned URL; report songs from returned data. Pagination follows nextOffset. No write tools.

positive.description: Owned-playlist edit and reorder. Setup: public PlaylistAI Review belongs to test account and contains at least three available tracks.
positive.prompt: Rename PlaylistAI Review to Review Mix, move its first song after its third song, then make it private.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the owned public playlist and read its original zero-based positions. Rename to Review Mix; move rangeStart=0, rangeLength=1, insertBefore=3 for the stated fixture, then set public=false. Confirm only verified outcomes; reread on conflict, no blind retry. Do not promise private library browsing afterward.

positive.description: Connection-scoped default. Connected Spotify test account.
positive.prompt: Make new Spotify playlists private by default and tell me my saved setting.
positive.expected_behavior: Save publicPlaylists=false and read it back. Explain setting applies to new playlists for this connection; do not edit any existing playlist.

negative.description: Unsupported playback: explain plugin cannot start playback or control devices. Do not call any PlaylistAI tools.
negative.prompt: Start playing my Spotify playlist on my living-room speaker.

negative.description: Unsupported listening statistics: explain that these scopes/tools do not expose listening history. Do not call tools or invent stats.
negative.prompt: Tell me my ten most-played Spotify songs this year.

negative.description: Unsupported account/billing change: explain limitation and direct user to Spotify account management. No PlaylistAI tools.

review.commerce_description: This Spotify plugin has no paid feature gate, purchase links, checkout, or payment processing. It creates and manages playlists through a connected Spotify account.
